skills.describe: Describe a distribution: shape, center, spread, unusual features, in context
skills.compare: Compare distributions with comparison words, not two separate lists
skills.sampling: Sampling: name the bias and its direction; write a procedure that can be followed
skills.design: Experiments: random assignment, what it allows, and blinding
skills.probability: Define the random variable, name the distribution, tie the probability to the claim
skills.interval: Interpret a confidence interval and the confidence level
skills.test: State a test conclusion: compare, evidence, direction, parameter, context
skills.errors: Type I and Type II errors in context, with the conditional clause
skills.conditions: Check conditions in words, with the numbers
skills.regression: Interpret slope, intercept, r squared, s and a residual in context
